description: This file defines the SubunitAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing organizational subunits in a Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting subunits, with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: SubunitAPI
classes.description: API class for managing organizational subunits, including CRUD operations and validation rules, with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single subunit by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for getting a single subunit.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subunits, with support for depth and mode filtering.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing subunits.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new subunit under a specified parent.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a subunit.

methods.name: setParamsToSubunit
methods.description: Sets request parameters into a Subunit entity instance.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing subunit identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a subunit.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting a subunit.
